title: Could your family find the important information in an emergency?

scenes.text: Could your family find important information during an emergency?
Keep key contacts, medications, and allergies organized.
Add school and child-care contacts, plus two family meeting places.
Store the information securely. Never post private family details publicly.

Review it every 6 months.
Prepared today. Stronger tomorrow.
